recommendation.first_deliverable: A hypothesis-and-rate match between a stated published cancellation theorem and the exact NS98 weighted projected quadratic sum, retaining the old Gram inverse, signs, growing shifts and scale average.
recommendation.cost_target: For fixed d_n=-mu(n)log(2N/n), bound (1/J) sum_{j=J}^{2J-1} K_{2^j} by a constant independent of sufficiently large dyadic J, where K_N=d^T(D-C^TG^{-1}C)d.
recommendation.companion: Keep NS91/93's compatible positive lower average of normalized actual residual numerator on the same index blocks. Cost alone does not imply RH.
recommendation.arithmetic_data: Actual Mobius multiplicativity and signed products, beyond the functional equation; no cancellation estimate for the required kernel is claimed available.
scope_cautions: NS98 already separated a bounded diagonal from the unestimated signed cross term; repeating that is not progress.
NS93 excludes the fully absolute product majorant, not the signed projected cost.
A logarithmic average over integers is not automatically an average of quadratic costs over dyadic sizes.
Fixed affine shifts do not give uniform estimates for all shifts up to the block length.
A little-o cancellation statement is not automatically the bounded absolute cost required here.
The weights contain an N-dependent old Gram inverse and cannot be treated as arbitrary harmless smooth weights.
A control sharing one partial cost estimate does not refute a route that also needs a distinguishing numerator hypothesis. Screen the stated combined implication, with actual hypothesis matching.
